Richie TMSTHREE TEMPLATE DIRECTIONS
Width
A · Waybill — warm paper, Fraunces-style serif headings, ruled bands with a label column, stamp chips. Closest to what is built today. B · Control room — dark board, split-flap times, LED states, top nav instead of a rail. Best for a dispatcher watching the clock; heaviest to read in daylight. C · Statement — cool white, one grotesque, hairlines, right-aligned figures, green accent. Best for money and audit; quietest to look at all day.

Same content in all three: attention, today's runs, fleet readiness, a form with an error state, and the setup rules. Use the width buttons to see each at tablet and phone.
